name: POLYWOOD

about:
POLYWOOD was founded in 1990 in a garage in Indiana. The company is headquartered in Syracuse, Indiana, and operates manufacturing facilities in both Indiana and North Carolina.

The company manufactures outdoor furniture including Adirondack chairs, dining sets, deep seating, chaise lounges, rockers, and in-pool furniture. Its proprietary lumber formulations—ClimateTuff™, Solidcore™, and ColorStay™—are extruded in-house and combined with marine-grade stainless steel fasteners coated with Xylan for corrosion resistance. Finished pieces are shipped directly to consumers and commercial clients, with a white-glove delivery option that includes assembly and placement.

POLYWOOD serves residential customers through its direct-to-consumer website and showrooms, and supplies the commercial hospitality sector via a dedicated Commercial & Hospitality program. Its furniture is specified for hotels, resorts, restaurants, and public spaces.

The brand differentiates itself with a 20-year warranty, low-maintenance materials that resist splintering, rotting, cracking, and fading, and a commitment to U.S. manufacturing since its founding. The integrated UV inhibitors lock in color, while the Solidcore™ construction provides structural endurance.
